ready: Clear all faults and restore default settings. Start the stack with the launcher. Keep background traffic unchanged; compare fresh 60–90-second windows and changes in rejected requests. Use Storefront for customer results and Grafana for workers, queue, rejections and dependency circuits.
cleanup: Clear faults, restore defaults, and allow in-flight requests and a 5-second cooldown to finish. Verify live stock and delivery for all products, then submit your measurements.
measurementGuidance: Include all products and catalog time/status; record queue size and new rejections from Grafana over the same window.
mitigationGuidance: Explain timeout, breaker and fallback separately.
